facts.note: Transcript gives the kitchen clock reading of a quarter past ten when the temple struck ten, and repeats that the clock is kept fast on purpose.
Lina comes down at twenty-three minutes to eleven by the kitchen clock and stays until after the temple strikes eleven.
Piano begins at twelve minutes to eleven and stops at one minute past eleven, both by the kitchen clock.
Hall clock strikes eleven when the kitchen clock shows three minutes past eleven.

added.quote: Then I went down to my kitchen to see to the glasses.
added.why: Gives an order: Rosa went down to the kitchen only after dinner was served and cleared, so she was in the kitchen after the dinner ended, which places her there at a point the sheet does not cover.
